purpose: Package caches (.pnpm-store, uv-cache) stay allowed: hardlinked files share one security descriptor, so a DENY there would reach node_modules/venvs in workspaces. Paths the Muse shell sandbox (local group MuseSandboxUsers) must not read. Muse 1.4.0 read-refresh grants the group RX on every top-level entry of the user profile; the D: drive is readable to every local account. Anything the sandbox reads can reach the model provider. ~/.agents stays readable as a whole (shared skills, runtimes); its sensitive parts are listed. agent-fleet/evidence is NOT denied: a live Fleet Muse canary (run-20260928T233837Z-a912d1774d) lost access to its own worktree under a denied evidence root (pytest/Set-Location UnauthorizedAccess).

drive_roots.reviewed_reparse_note: ExampleSolutions-RAG: junction to E:\Example Solutions\RAG, target absent (checked 2026-09-29); any future target on E: falls under the E: rule below.
drive_roots.allow_note: Company folders on D: are ACTIVE development locations (client app repos/worktrees used by Fleet/Muse, e.g. D:\Example Solutions\app-worktrees). Denying them breaks Muse workspaces and git (regression seen 2026-09-29 on agent-fleet/evidence). Denied on D: are non-code data only; new top-level entries stay denied by default until reviewed.
Backup trees carry their own protected ACLs; a probe from the Muse sandbox got DENIED on WorkstationBackup (2026-09-29).
